name: Tiger
intro: A tiger is the biggest wild cat. It has orange fur with black stripes.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A tiger is the biggest cat in the world.
It has orange fur with black stripes.
Its belly is white.
No two tigers have the same stripes.
It has big paws with sharp claws.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Tigers live in Asia.
Some tigers live in hot, wet rain forests.
Some tigers live in cold, snowy forests.
Tigers like to live near water.
They scratch trees to mark their home.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Tigers are carnivores, so they eat meat.
They hunt deer, wild pigs, and buffalo.
They hunt mostly at night.
They usually hunt alone.
They sneak up quietly on their food.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: Baby tigers are called cubs.
A mom tiger usually has 2 to 4 cubs.
Cubs are born with their eyes closed.
Cubs grow very fast in their first month.
Mom cares for them until they are about one and a half years old.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Tigers love to swim.
Tigers see much better at night than people do.
Tigers cannot purr, but they can make a soft chuff sound.
The tiger is the national animal of India.
Tigers are endangered, so people work to protect them.

vocab.meaning: A baby tiger, lion, or bear.
